prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Create one square sheet with EXACTLY four equal square panels in a strict 2x2 layout. Each panel repeats the SAME premium miniature white-clay jacket hanging on one simple hanger, shown during a fitting adjustment in four motion phases. The fitting pin shifts gently at the jacket's side seam: phase 1 pin at waist, phase 2 pin presses and gathers a tiny fold, phase 3 the fit looks smooth and a small embossed approval check appears beside the jacket, phase 4 check fades and pin returns to the starting position. Keep the jacket, hanger, camera and lighting identical across phases. Clearly communicate prototype fitting and approval.
Scene/backdrop: transparent, no extra scene.
Subject: one elegant tailored jacket on a hanger, one small fitting pin and one small check mark; same forms in all tiles.
Style/medium: charming premium softly rounded white-clay/paper 3D miniature icon, tactile matte white materials, subtle pale neutral-grey dimensional shading, refined fashion illustration, friendly sophisticated finish, consistent with a premium fashion workflow icon.
Composition/framing: same fixed camera, centered complete hanger and jacket, identical scale and position, generous transparent margins in each equal tile; exact 2x2 arrangement, no dividers.
Lighting/mood: diffused soft studio light, gentle contact shadow.
Color palette: white and pale neutral grey only; transparent alpha outside subject.
Materials/textures: matte paper-clay jacket with delicate seams, softly sculpted hanger and tiny pin.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: exactly four related successive frames, consistent design and placement; only fitting pin movement, small fold change and check appearance; preserve transparent background.
Avoid: people, mannequin body, hands, other clothes, colors, beige, black background, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, grid lines, borders, different camera, crop, flat vector or crude line art.
